FN-YKFZ26-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 18
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chris England
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/10/2023
House Bill 18 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Corrections, by an undetermined amount, to change the frequency of when reports are provided
to the Joint Legislative Prison Oversight Committee from quarterly, under current law, to
monthly.
